name: Smashed Eggs with Avocado & Chilli
method: Lower the eggs into a pan of boiling water and boil for 6 minutes. Drain, cool under cold running water for 1 minute, then peel.
Meanwhile melt the butter with the smoked paprika and chilli flakes in a small pan over a low heat for 1 minute.
Toast the bread. Dice the avocado, toss it in the lime juice and spoon it onto the toast slices.
Break the eggs over the avocado, drizzle with the spiced butter, scatter over the coriander and serve.
